events.text: Ludwig Martens died.
events.subject: self
events.quote: − 19 October 1948 ) was a Russian Marxist revolutionary

events.text: Ludwig Martens was born in Bachmut, in the Yekaterinoslav Governorate of the Russian Empire.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Ludwig Martens was born on 1 January 1875 n.s . in Bachmut

events.text: Martens graduated from a Kursk Realschule.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1893 Martens graduated from a Kursk Realschule

events.text: Martens entered Saint Petersburg State Institute of Technology.
events.subject: self
events.object: Saint Petersburg State Institute of Technology
events.quote: In 1893 Martens graduated from a Kursk Realschule and entered Saint Petersburg State Institute of Technology

events.text: Martens was arrested.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1896 he was arrested

events.text: Martens was deported to Germany as a German national.
events.subject: self
events.quote: in 1899 as a German national was deported to Germany

events.text: Martens became a member of the Social Democratic Party of Germany.
events.subject: self
events.quote: in 1899 as a German national was deported to Germany where he became a member of the Social Democratic Party of Germany

events.text: Martens graduated from the Technical College of Charlottenburg.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1902 he graduated from the Technical College of Charlottenburg

events.text: Martens emigrated to Great Britain.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1906 , following the failure of the 1905 Russian Revolution , Martens emigrated to Great Britain

events.text: The Kursk steel mill owned by Martens family was confiscated by the Russian government.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: In 1915 , with the onset of World War I , the Kursk steel mill owned by Martens family was confiscated by the Russian government

events.text: Martens emigrated to the United States.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1916 Martens emigrated to the United States

events.text: Martens returned from the United States to Russia.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1917 , after the February Revolution , Martens – together with Leon Trotsky and 278 other Russian Social Democrats – returned from the United States to Russia

events.text: Martens returned to the United States.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In March 1919 Martens returned to the United States

events.text: Martens founded the Russian Soviet Government Bureau.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In March 1919 Martens returned to the United States and founded the Russian Soviet Government Bureau

events.text: The Bureau was searched by police.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: In June 1919 the Bureau was searched by police

events.text: Martens stated in Washington, D.C., that he had done nothing to justify being deported.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Martens stated in Washington , D.C. , on January 10 , 1920 , that he had done nothing to justify being deported

events.text: Martens was finally deported to Soviet Russia.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Martens was finally deported to Soviet Russia in January 1921

events.text: Martens became a member of the Supreme Soviet of the National Economy.
events.subject: self
events.object: Supreme Soviet of the National Economy
events.quote: Martens became a member of the Supreme Soviet of the National Economy

events.text: Martens became the Chairman of Glavmetal.
events.subject: self
events.quote: the Chairman of Glavmetal

events.text: Martens started works on developing the Kursk Magnetic Anomaly.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Martens started works on developing the Kursk Magnetic Anomaly

events.text: Martens started work as the first Chairman of the Committee on Invention of the Supreme Soviet of the National Economy.
events.subject: self
events.object: Committee on Invention of the Supreme Soviet of the National Economy
events.quote: In 1924−26 Martens worked as the first Chairman of the Committee on Invention

events.text: Martens's chairmanship of the Committee on Invention ended.
events.subject: self
events.object: Committee on Invention of the Supreme Soviet of the National Economy
events.quote: In 1924−26 Martens worked as the first Chairman of the Committee on Invention

events.text: Martens published a monograph, On the vibration of piston engines.
events.subject: self
events.object: On the vibration of piston engines
events.quote: In 1925 he published a monograph , On the vibration of piston engines

events.text: Martens started work as the Head of the Research and Development Institutes for Diesel Manufacturing in Leningrad.
events.subject: self
events.object: Research and Development Institutes for Diesel Manufacturing
events.quote: In 1926−36 Martens worked as the Head of the Research and Development Institutes for Diesel Manufacturing

events.text: The diesel was tested.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The diesel was tested in 1932

events.text: Martens became the Chief Editor of the Technical Encyclopedia.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1927−41 he was the Chief Editor of the Technical Encyclopedia

events.text: Martens's role as Chief Editor of the Technical Encyclopedia ended.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1927−41 he was the Chief Editor of the Technical Encyclopedia

events.text: Martens wrote a letter to OGPU in support of the arrested Pavel Florensky.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1933 Martens wrote a letter to OGPU in support of the arrested Pavel Florensky

events.text: Martens retired.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Martens retired in 1941 .

events.text: Martens died in Moscow.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He died in Moscow on 19 October 1948

events.text: Martens was buried in Novodevichy Cemetery.
events.subject: self
events.quote: was buried in Novodevichy Cemetery

events.text: The Free Germany committee was organized in Krasnogorsk.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: The committee was organized in Krasnogorsk in 1943 .
